skill.summary: Generates a meta-architecture for substantial entrepreneurial ventures – including business model, tech stack, funding roadmap, and agent orchestration.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of meta-entre skill.

- Generates structured meta-architectures for ambitious entrepreneurial ventures.
- Covers business model, technology stack, funding roadmap, and agent orchestration.
- Output includes vision & strategy, operational model, technical architecture, funding milestones, and execution roadmap.
- Designed to work from prompts like “create meta architecture” or “setup entrepreneurial scaffold.”
